session_policy: A fresh session id may be used per self-contained prompt; the user identity never changes.
quota_policy: Maximum 30 outbound queries; stop on first explicit quota signal; no retries.

counting_policy.live_message: Every outbound query accepted for transport
counting_policy.observed_answer: A response reaching answer_end with non-empty content
counting_policy.mapped_live_cell: A unique P05 execution_id with exact prompt_sha256 and observed terminal response
